styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent premium retro-tech wearable visual system across the whole image set. Fixed palette: seamless base fields of deep matte studio tone #3B2F29, neutral matte stone tone #DCD9D4 and clean paper tone #F7F5F2, with a single accent of screen-glow #4FC3E8; product materials pinned to brushed knurled metal and matte silicone #2B2A29. Typography: modern geometric sans-serif only, one headline block plus short label lines, Chinese copy wrapped in 「」, no serif or handwritten faces. Background system: seamless studio sweeps built only from the three locked base tones, never unrelated scenery. Lighting system: large soft front-left key, thin rim highlight on metal edges, 5200K-5800K, controlled specular falloff, soft grounded contact shadow, no harsh cast shadow. Surface system: matte paper and stone sweeps, with crumpled cloth #2F3B4A and ceramic #E4E0DA permitted only in the lifestyle frame. Layout system: top-centre or left headline block, two-column and four-cell icon grids, hairline dividers and leader lines, numbered circles for spec cells. Icon system: thin monoline outline glyphs, uniform 2px stroke, rounded terminals. Product presentation rules: the case face and strap construction stay readable, product scale is stable between shots, the screen is never blown out, the watch face is a generic placeholder layout with no legible text. No drift: no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no recoloured case finishes, no invented on-screen UI, no real phone-system logos, no watermarks, no QR codes or membership badges.

provenance.notes: 由 8 张详情页切片拆解（源目录 _sources/手表/panels）。品类：L1 珠宝饰品 与源类别（饰品装饰品）一致，源目录名为手表（珠宝饰品下的同名 L2），但画面主体为方形触屏智能手表（心率/计步/睡眠/久坐提醒、触屏应用栅格、无线连接、充电与硬件参数图），故 L2 取智能穿戴而非手表，与源夹名不冲突。productFamily 取 electronics（带屏设备，防假 UI 优先于珠宝闪光逻辑）。与库内既有三版腕表的差异：男士复古皮带石英表＝圆形表壳＋皮表带＋石英机芯＋木纹黄铜暗调；情侣对表＝自动机械＋钢带＋亮白冷调礼赠；女士镶钻玫瑰金表＝镶钻圆壳＋皮表带＋暖柔粉奶油绒长图。本版为唯一智能穿戴：方形触屏表壳＋哑光硅胶孔眼表带＋健康监测与消息提醒诉求，视觉体系为深棕底场 #3B2F29／中性石灰 #DCD9D4／纸白 #F7F5F2 加屏幕强调 #4FC3E8 的室内无缝棚拍＋线框图标信息图，不用木纹、毛绒、礼盒缎面或冷调白光。已剥离：原图所有中英文案与诗意短句、表盘莲花与游鱼图案及时间数字、电话系统标识图形、芯片型号与一切数值（屏幕尺寸、分辨率、防水等级、蓝牙版本、电池容量均改为 {callout_*} 占位符，禁止编造认证与测试数据）、底部加入会员／全店免费角标与二维码、店铺信息与人名。佩戴与痛点镜均以手腕／前臂裁切构图并显式排除可识别面部；微距镜锁定表盘、表冠、表壳滚花与表带孔眼。promptTemplate 中的 {product} 与 {style_lock} 为生成时注入占位符，故未展开；styleLock.lockText 为唯一权威锁文本，注入后各镜逐字一致，机位／背景／目的逐镜变化。全景镜 4/11 约 36%，机位含 3/4 平视、高 45 度、正 0 度、90 度俯视、90 度侧面、低 20 度与仰视共 7 类。
